response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web engineer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang backgrounds, but the profile fundamentally mismatches this role. There is no evidence of native-level Japanese proficiency (a hard requirement), no Linux kernel investigation or modification experience, and no background in network security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X), L2/L3 switching, or embedded firmware development. C experience is limited to a brief 7-month stint over a decade ago.
strengths: Broad, long-tenured software development experience (15+ years) across multiple stacks
Some systems-level exposure: low-latency DLang services, C/C++ at National Instruments, Linux familiarity
Strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions, community teaching)
concerns: No indication of Japanese language ability — a mandatory native-level requirement
No embedded networking, LAN-switch, security-protocol, or Linux kernel development experience
Minimal professional C/UNIX experience; career trajectory centers on web and application development
